Centrality API Reference

This page documents all centrality functions available in SNA.jl.

Degree Centrality

SNA.degree_centrality — Function
degree_centrality(net; mode=:total, normalized=false) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute degree centrality for all vertices.

Arguments

  • net: Network object
  • mode::Symbol=:total: Type of degree (:in, :out, or :total)
  • normalized::Bool=false: Normalize by maximum possible degree

Returns

  • Vector of centrality scores, one per vertex
source

Betweenness Centrality

SNA.betweenness_centrality — Function
betweenness_centrality(net; normalized=true) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute betweenness centrality for all vertices.

Betweenness centrality measures the extent to which a vertex lies on paths between other vertices.

source

Closeness Centrality

SNA.closeness_centrality — Function
closeness_centrality(net; normalized=true) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute closeness centrality for all vertices.

Closeness centrality measures how close a vertex is to all other vertices (inverse of average shortest path length).

source

Eigenvector Centrality

SNA.eigenvector_centrality — Function
eigenvector_centrality(net; max_iter=100, tol=1e-6) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute eigenvector centrality for all vertices.

A vertex has high eigenvector centrality if it is connected to other high-centrality vertices.

source

Bonacich Power Centrality

SNA.bonacich_power — Function
bonacich_power(net; β=0.5, normalized=true) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute Bonacich power centrality.

Arguments

  • net: Network object
  • β::Float64=0.5: Attenuation factor (-1/λmax < β < 1/λmax)
  • normalized::Bool=true: Normalize results

Bonacich power centrality accounts for both the number and quality of connections, with β controlling how much weight is given to indirect ties.

source

Katz Centrality

SNA.katz_centrality — Function
katz_centrality(net; α=0.1, β=1.0) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute Katz centrality.

Similar to eigenvector centrality but with damping factor α.

source

PageRank

SNA.pagerank — Function
pagerank(net; α=0.85, max_iter=100, tol=1e-6) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute PageRank centrality.

source

Flow Betweenness

SNA.flowbet — Function
flowbet(net) -> Vector{Float64}

Compute flow betweenness centrality.

Flow betweenness considers all paths (not just shortest) weighted by their length.

source
